newsitem.title: CANADA: Rayrock sells off share of gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Rayrock sells off share of gold mine.

text.p: Rayrock Yellowknife Resources said on Monday that it and three other partners had agreed to sell their collective 47.5 percent in the Pinson gold mine to remaining partners Homestake Mining Co and Barrick Gold Corp for US$8.4 million and a small royalty.
Rayrock, which holds a 26.5 percent interest in the partnership, will receive approximately US$4.7 million from the sale, a company official said.
"Our minority interest in Pinson is not a strategic asset," Rayrock Chairman David Crombie said.
"We will focus our efforts on the expansion of Rayrock's 100 percent-owned Dee Mine and on reserve delineation drilling at our 66.6 percent-owned Marigold Mine."

The Pinson mine has produced about one million ounces of gold since operations began in 1981, and it is estimated that another 180,000 ounces of reserves are mineable through open-pit operations, the company said.
